stance: Growth: consumer spending is firm. September retail sales rose 0.77% m/m after 1.29% in August, with ex-auto at 0.72% and yoy accelerating to 6.29%. The m/m pace is cooling from a strong August, but the level is high. Consensus and control group were unavailable, so GDP consumption read is unconfirmed. Would turn cautious if ex-auto m/m goes negative or ISM New Orders fall below 50.
